{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|What model are you? ISB-one-twenty?''"<br />"''One-twenty? Don't insult me. My processor speed is fifty-point-three-two times faster than the one-twenty's.|Chewbacca and ISBy|<ref name="Forest">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref>}}
'''ISBy''' was a [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]] of a model that it bragged had a more powerful processor&mdash;the [[GwendoLyn Six]]&mdash;than the [[ISB-120]]. It was employed by the [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] known as [[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|"It"]] to break into a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] which was owned by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. ISBy was destroyed when [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his wife, [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], tried to rescue their son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] from IT's plans.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' inaccurately labels ISBy as an ISB-120, despite the text of ''[[A Forest Apart]]'' stating otherwise.
